'''Winsafra Hunt down And Rape the Jedi, errr, wait, what jedi, they're all out of play :P''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Winsafra]]
* '''Published:''' 10 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 HD Winsafra DS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

the dark side, much more enticing, much more appealing, much more powerful, whats not to like? join our ranks now and gain the benefits of 2 dark jedi masters! how could you possibly lose? :P

The published list has 58 cards.

== Strategy ==

basic strategy, get vader to a battleground, if they send jedi to stop you, smoosh them with him and maul. then put them out of play(thank you darth sidious sitting on the executor) dark jedi rock in small numbers :P
